task.observation: own hand and public features only; static319/430, history5x162; action54
task.legal_actions: complete canonical ragged card multisets; no clipping
task.engine: frozen native CPU and resident CUDA; pinned DouZero oracle

modes.seconds: one job at a time; research_worker_seconds of the worker
modes.usd: up to 4 jobs and 2 GPUs at once (every worker has one GPU); usd_mode_research_usd of worker time at usd_per_worker_second; a queued or running job holds its whole grant

usd_mode.concurrency: parallel: up to 4 jobs, 2 GPUs, 64 CPU cores

starter.algorithm: terminal WP three-role DMC; RMSprop; pure self-play

evaluation.candidate_controls: one role per game; both other seats use same panel bot, including peasant teammate
evaluation.reference_normalized: null until independent multi-seed calibration qualifies
evaluation.faults: no ordinary score for illegal, timeout, simulator fault or incomplete schedule

commands.smoke: .venv-doudizhu-ar/bin/python -m harness run doudizhu network --release RELEASE --out SESSION --smoke --model MODEL --execute
